Commentary.Commentary: So Bangladesh need 287 from their 50 overs in order to inflict their first whitewash against Sri Lanka. The batting has finally delivered for Sri Lanka but can the bowlers back it up now? Join us for the chase to find out.

Taskin Ahmed was the star of the show with the ball. Bangladesh started off poorly as they were dominated in Powerplay 1. At that stage, it looked like they would be chasing a total above 320. The bowlers though fired back with Taskin taking the charge. He finished with 4/46 and surprisingly did not bowl his full quota of 10. Mustafizur, Shakib, and Mehidy all went wicketless but were economical. Mosaddek and Shoriful were expensive but the latter was the only other bowler to get a wicket.

Winning the toss and opting to bat, Sri Lanka got off the blocks quickly as Gunathilaka and Perera started with a bang and raced to an 82 run stand. Gunathilka though could not capitalize on the start and Nissanka too fell quickly. Perera though carried on and the skipper was the star. As his 120 put Sri Lanka in a good position. Dhananjaya played a good second fiddle scoring a fifty. The visitors did lose their way in the middle but finished the innings with a bang.

A very improved batting performance from Sri Lanka and though at one stage it looked they would get in excess of 300, they will be content with their effort. Bangladesh will not be too displeased either. They will take solace in the fact that they have managed to restrict the tourists under 300.
A couple to finish their innings here! 18 off the final over! Again, short and around off, hooked to the wide long on region for two runs. SRI LANKA END ON 286/6!
Shortish and on off, pulled to deep square leg for a couple.

FOUR! That brings up Dhananjaya de Silva's half ton and it his sixth ODI half century. Has played well and will want to tonk the last two balls for two big shots. Width offered outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva whacks this one over the cover region for a boundary.
Leg bye. On the pads, takes the pad as it misses Mendis' bat and goes to the keeper and the batters scamper through for the leg bye.
Slower back of a length ball on off, this is slogged away to long on for one.
Slower length ball around middle, heaved again to deep mid-wicket for one.
NO BALL AND SIX! This is the last thing that Islam wanted. A waist high full toss on middle, this is heaved away to the deep square leg region for a biggie. Free Hit coming up...
Shoriful Islam to bowl the final over of the innings.
Slower length ball on off, this is heaved away towards deep mid-wicket for one.
A full toss on middle, Ramesh Mendis looks to work this one to the leg side but he inside edges it back onto his pads, and the ball finds it's way back to the bowler.
Short and quick way outside off, Ramesh looks to extend his arms and smash it away, but he does not do so.
Outside off, played softly towards the short third man fielder for one.
The new man in is Ramesh Mendis who makes his way out to the middle for the first time in ODIs.

OUT! TAKEN! Hasaranga wanted to go big, but he has to go home here. Can't blame him for trying a big shot as they are in the penultimate over. A good length ball on off, Wanindu Hasaranga smacks this one down the ground. It has height. Looks like he has the distance too, but Mehidy Hasan runs to his left, from long on and pouches the skier.
Commentary.Howout: c Mehidy Hasan b Taskin Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: A slower short ball outside off, Wanindu Hasaranga looks to cut this one over the point fielder, but only connects his swing with the air around him.
Who will bowl the penultimate over of the innings? It will be Taskin Ahmed.
Around off, this is pushed to covers for a single to end the over.
Leg bye. Bowls a slower one at the pads, Dhananjaya de Silva swivels and pulls but does not connect with the ball well. Takes the pad and goes to the short fine leg fielder for a leg bye.
Slightly fuller but outside off, this is drilled down the ground, towards long off for a single.
A good length ball around off, this is lofted towards long off and the strike is rotated.
Full and wide outside off, this is guided to point, who fields well. One run though.
Skips down and plays this with an angled bat, to covers, for one.
Very well bowled! A full toss outside off, de Silva, again, does not manage to dig this one out.
A fuller and slower ball outside off, de Silva reaches out, but fails to connect bat with ball.
Drilled to long off this time, for only one though.
Review time! Tamim did not look interested but then opts to take the review. Looks like a hopeful one. Let's see what the replays have to say.

NOT OUT! A full ball on leg, de Silva looks to work this one to the leg side but misses and the ball takes the pad and goes to the leg side, as the batters take one. An appeal for LBW but turned down. Tamim Iqbal enquires with his teammates and then makes the 'T' symbol. No need for Ultra Edge as the TV umpire is sure, that it missed the bat. Ball Tracker shows that the ball had pitched outside leg. Will be not out.
FOUR! WHACK! A length ball around off, Dhananjaya de Silva knows that the mid off fielder is up and just lofts this one over him and the ball finds the ropes.
Outside off, stroked through point for a single.
Outside off, Hasaranga looks to drive but only manages to generate an outside edge, towards short third man and the batters take the single.
An off cutter again, just in that channel outside off, Wanindu Hasaranga swings his blade at this but misses again. A wry smile on the face of the batter.
On the body, this is pulled nicely to the fielder at square leg for one.
Length and around off, slammed in front of point for one.
A slower length ball outside off, Wanindu Hasaranga swings and misses.

Mustafizur Rahman has been struck on his bowling hand, in the previous delivery and is in some pain now. The physio is out in the middle, to have a look at the same. The magic spray is out and it looks like Mustafizur Rahman is ready to continue.
A good length ball on off, this is slammed back to the bowler, who half stops the ball, towards the leg side, for a single.
WIDE. Down the leg side and it is wided by the umpire.
FOUR! Looked so good. A length ball, in the slot around off, Wanindu Hasaranga lofts this one nonchalantly over covers. Boundary.

Around off, Dhananjaya de Silva waits for the ball to arrive and then guides it to the short third man fielder. The batters scamper through for the single, as the fielder scores a direct hit at the striker's end. It won't matter as Wanindu Hasaranga was well in.
A full toss on leg, this is flicked to the left of the short fine leg fielder. A single.
Worked to long off for one.
In the air...safe! Slower short ball on middle, pulled away, but the ball lands ahead of the deep mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Outside off, cut away to the point fielder this time.
Shakib Al Hasan is done for the day. Who will replace him? It is Shoriful Islam (6-0-31-1), who comes back into the attack.
Slowish length ball on off, this is pushed through point for one. A tidy over, just 5 off this one.
Length ball way outside off, Wanindu Hasaranga swings his blade at this but only connects with the thin air around him.
Slower back of a length ball around off, bunted to mid off for an easy single.
Another single as this is an action replay of the previous delivery.
Slower length ball on off, this is driven crisply through cover-point for a single.
Around middle, this is worked through square leg for one. They wanted two but had to settle for just the single now.
On the pads, nudged to square leg for one run.
Fired on middle, pushed through mid on for one.
Goes back and punches this one through covers for one. Wanindu Hasaranga is underway here.
Who's in now? The hero of the first game, Wanindu Hasaranga trudges out now.

OUT! RUN OUT! The batters look for a quick single and they end up losing another wicket for Sri Lanka! Dickwella was caught well short and Bangladesh will be very happy with this wicket. Dragged short and on middle and off, Dhananjaya de Silva comes down the deck and taps this one towards mid on, and the batters scamper through for the single. The fielder there, Shoriful Islam picks up the ball and aims at the keeper's end. He hits and the third umpire is called. One replay is enough to see that Niroshan Dickwella is well short.
Is that a run out? Looks close. Let's see what the replays say.
Niroshan Dickwella puts on his skates and whips this one through mid on for a single.
Around off, placed ahead of the cover fielder for an easy single.
Very well bowled! A well guided yorker on middle, ND can only dig this one out.
Slower length ball on off, Dickwella guides this with a reverse bat, to the backward point fielder.
Around off, worked to mid off awkwardly for one.
Pushed to the cover fielder this time.
Good length ball on off, this is chipped over the cover region and the batters take two.
A full toss on off, this is bunted to wide long on for one.
The reverse sweep it out now! This is hit over the point fielder and the ball lands just ahead of the deep point fielder. A single to end the over. 8 from the over!
Goes back and works this through mid-wicket. One.

Well fielded by the man in the deep. Floated and around off, Niroshan Dickwella skips down the track and plays the inside-out shot over covers. The man in the deep covers a lot of ground, running to his left and pulls the ball back, before it touches the ropes. Saves a single as the batters take three.
Fuller on middle, this is swept away to fine leg for one.
Uses his feet to come down the track and clips this through mid-wicket for one.
Hit hard towards the long off region for a single.
Time for Powerplay 3! Now, a maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle, until the end of the innings.
Outside off, ND swings but misses yet again. A good over comes to an end!
Length ball outside off, Niroshan Dickwella swings his blade at this but misses.
Around off, this is dug out, via the inside edge, to the leg side for one.
Shortish and around off, Dhananjaya de Silva looks to pull but misses.
Who comes out now? Niroshan Dickwella, it is.

OUT! TAKEN! A fine innings by the Sri Lankan skipper comes to an end here. He looked to go big, but did not time it well and holed out to long off this time. This is a length ball, outside off, Kusal Perera goes through with the big shot towards the long off region. Gets height but does not get the distance on this. Mahmudullah keeps his eyes on the ball and takes a very good catch. Perera goes back for 120 and this has been a captain's knock from him.
A well disguised slower ball, fuller on off, KP looks to sweep this one away, but he misses.
Floated on off, Dhananjaya pushes it back to the bowler.
Follows the boundary with a single towards fine leg for one.
FOUR! Very good shot! Floated on middle and off, Perera brings out the reverse sweep it behind point for a boundary.
Shorter around off, Dhananjaya comes down the track and plays it to long on for one.
Flat on middle and off, Dhananjaya blocks it.
In the air but falls short! Short around off, Perera mistimes his pull but it falls in front of deep mid-wicket. Single taken.
Full outside off, Dhananjaya looks to drive but gets beaten.  6 off Shoriful's over.
Around off, de Silva pushes it to cover.
FOUR! Not perfectly timed but good enough to get a boundary! Shortish ball outside off, Dhananjaya flat bats it over mid off for a boundary.
Appeal for caught bheind but only from Mushfiqur. Outside off on a length, Dhananjaya looks to play but misses.
WIDE! Attempted oof pace delivery from Shoriful but he misses his radar. Bowls it down the legs side.
Back of a length delivery outside off. Perera punches it to long on for one.
Shoriful starts his new spell with a lenght ball outside off. Perera looks to whack it across the line but misses.
Slower delivery outside off. Dhananjaya looks to run it down through third man but misses.
Slower delivery on the pads. Perera tucks it to the left of short fine leg for one.
Slower ball but misses the radar as it is on the pads. No problem for Dhananjaya to tuck it to fine leg for one.
Full around off, Dhananjaya charges down the track and hits it hard but straight to short extra cover.
Slower ball on off. Dhananjaya keeps it out.
Outside off, punched to sweeper cover by the Lankan skipper for a single. Brings up the 50-run stand between this duo.
Darted quicker on the pads, Dhananjaya looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Short on middle and leg, Perera punches it to long off to get a single and bring up the 200 for Sri Lanka.
Flatter around off, Perera taps it to point.
Floated on off, Dhananjaya reverse sweeps it behind point for a single.
Tossed up on off, Perera milks it to cover for one.
Short on off, Perera punches it to the bowler.
TOP EDGE AND FOUR! Shortish and around off, Dhananjaya de Silva looks to pull this one to the leg side but the ball takes the top edge and goes over to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Around off, nudged to square leg for one.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Perera looks to tuck but misses. Wide signalled.
Slammed to deep square leg for a single.
Outside off, slapped to point for a single.
Leg bye. A length ball on leg, Dhananjaya de Silva looks to tuck but misses and gets hit on the pads as the batters take a run. An appeal for LBW but turned down.
Length ball, outside off. Pulled away to deep mid-wicket for one.
They are nicely negotiating the threat of Mehidy Hasan! Shorter ball, on off. Perera cuts it to deep cover for one.
Nicely tossed up, outside off. Kusal Perera drives it to cover.
Darted on the pads. Dhananjaya de Silva clips it easily to deep square leg for one.
Another shorter ball, outside off. Kusal punches it to deep cover for one.
Floated around off, Dhananjay shuffles inside his crease and glances it to the on side for one.
Short on off, Perera punches it to cover and rotates the strike.
Mehidy is back.
Floated on the pads, Perera turns it to mid-wicket and keeps the strike.
Floated on off, Dhananjaya stokes it down the ground for one.
On the pads, Perera turns it to the on side for one.
Flights one on middle, Dhananjaya milks it to long on for one.
Floated on off, Dhananjaya pushes it back to the bowler.
Floated on middle and off, Perera taps it to point for one.

Drinks! It has been an even contest so far. Just when it looks like Sri Lanka are on the ascendency, Bangladesh manage to get a wicket and pull things back. Kusal Perera has been fantastic and will look to regather his focus and build on his 6th ODI ton. The pitch has looked good to bat on and the tourists will be looking to get to a score in excess of 275 from here on.

HUNDRED FOR KUSAL PERERA! What a fantastic knock it has been from the Sri Lankan skiper. The captain has led from the front but he knows that the job is not done and he needs to convert this into a daddy ton! Full on the pads, Perera turns it through square leg and gets a single to bring up his mileston. All his teammates are on their feet to applaud their skipper and his magnificent innings.

DROPPED! Perera gets a massive lifeline on 99! Mahmudullah has put down the Sri Lankan skipper on 99. Slower delivery on middle and leg, Perera looks to flick but the ball comes slow. It takes the top edge and lobs towards mid on. Mahmudullah comes running in, makes the ground. He puts a dive but fails to hold onto it.
Good running and Perera moves to 99! Back of a length delivery outside off, Perera runs it down fine towards third man and takes two to get to 99!
Outside off, Dhananjaya milks it to sweeper cover and takes one.
Another slower one outside off, Perera runs it down to third man for one.
Slower ball outside off, Perera punches it to cover.
Mustafizur Rahman is back!
On the pads, Kusal flicks it to the leg side and keeps the strike.
Flighted around off, Dhananjaya strokes it away to cover.
On off, Dhananjaya pushes it to cover.
Flighted on off, Dhananjaya pushes it to cover.
Flighted on the stumps, Dhananjaya comes down and pushes it back to the bowler.
Floated on off, Dhananjaya pushes it to the bowler.
Good length delivery on off, Perera taps it to point.
Outside off, Dhananjaya punches it to sweeper cover and gets to the other end.
Outside off, Dhananjaya dabs it to short third man.
Length ball outside off, Perera punches it through cover for one.
FOUR! Perera gets closer to a ton now! Short on middle and off, Perera pulls it over square leg for a boundary.
On middle and leg, Perera turns it to mid-wicket.
On the pads again. This time Kusal glances it to mid-wicket.
Floated on the pads, Perera flicks it but cannot go past short fine leg.
Quicker on off, Perera taps it out.
On the pads, Dhananjaya flicks it behind the leg side for one.
Darted quicker outside off, Dhananjaya looks to drive but misses.
On the pads, Perera flicks it behind square on the leg side for one.
Hooked behind square on the leg side, for a single to end the over.
Length ball on off, DdS taps this to covers and scampers through for a quick single.
Shortish around off, pulled to deep square leg for one.
Outside off, tapped to covers.

NOT OUT! A good decision to take the review and de Silva bats on here. A back of a length ball around off, coming in with the angle, de Silva hops and looks to tuck this one to the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads. A loud appeal and after a couple of seconds, up goes the umpire's finger. The batters have a chat and decide to go for the review. A good decision as Ultra Edge shows no bat and the ball seems to be missing the wickets, according to the Ball Tracker. The on-field decision has been overturned.
Review time! Dhananjaya de Silva has been adjudged LBW but a quick signal from Kusal Perera from the non striker's end has seen Dhananjaya go for the review. Let's see what the replays have to say.
On the pads, flicked to fine leg for one.
Around off and middle, pushed to mid on. Just 5 from the over!
Around off, kept out.
Outside off, this is stroked through covers. One.
Swept away gently to the left of the fine leg fielder and two runs are collected easily.
Fuller and around off, this is pushed to long off. One more run.
Worked on the leg side for a single.
Top over from Ahmed! A good length ball around off, kept out by de Silva.
Outside off, left alone.

Some confusion but no harm done for Sri Lanka! Around off, pushed to covers and de Silva comes ahead, looking for the single, but there is some hesitation from his partner. In the end, they do not risk the single.
Fuller and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Who will walk out to bat now? It is Dhananjaya de Silva!

OUT! TAKEN! Taskin strikes again and Kusal Mendis has thrown his wicket away. Sri Lanka would have wanted him to continue but this stand, which was looking good, has been broken apart. This is bowled shortish and wide outside off, Kusal Mendis sees an opportunity to score some runs and swings his blade wildly at this and the ball takes the top edge and goes high up in the air towards mid off, where Tamim Iqbal has the easiest of takes. Ahmed gets his third and Bangladesh will look to build on this.
Commentary.Howout: c Tamim Iqbal b Taskin Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: On the pads, clipped to fine leg for a single.
Change in bowling. Tamim continues to chop and change as Taskin is back on.

DROPPED! Perera was the man who would have been out, had this catch been taken, but he has been handed a lifeline. Around middle, slightly shortish, Kusal Perera comes down the track and looks to bang it away, but the ball takes the top edge and goes high up in the air towards the mid on region. The man runs behind, but at the last moment, makes a meal of it. A single. 150 up for Sri Lanka too!
Milked through mid on for a single now.
Tossed up and on middle, nudged through square leg and the strike is handed to Mendis.
A fumble by the fielder at covers and so the batters take the single on offer.
On off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Outside off, dabbed to the off side for one.
Given air and around off, KM nudges it to the leg side. Expensive over as they concede 14 from it!
Punched to long off for one.
SIX! Another short delivery and this has gone all the way. Another short ball around off, easy work for Perera as he hangs back and pumps this one over mid-wicket.
Shortish and around off, just pushed away to point.
On middle, flicked through square leg for one.
SIX! You bowl it short and Kusal Mendis does not miss out. Shortish on middle, Kusal Mendis shuffles around in his crease and drags his pull all the way over deep mid-wicket.
Change in bowling. Mosaddek Hossain is back into the attack. 18 from his 2 overs so far.
Well swept away here! Worked towards deep square leg for a brace to end the over.
On middle, played to mid-wicket.
Fuller on leg, Kusal Perera looks to sweep but misses. An appeal for LBW but this one was pitching outside leg for sure.
DROPPED! Fired on middle, Kusal Perera reverse sweeps this one towards the backward point fielder, and he lunges to his left, but fails to hold on. A couple.
On middle, glanced to mid-wicket for one.
Shortish around off, this is pushed to point.
Around off, played towards point.
On off, defended.
Outside off, dragged short here, Kusal Mendis goes back and punches this to sweeper cover for one.
Quick run! Around off, this is tapped through covers for a pacy single. Good running and understanding from the batters!
Comes down and clips this through mid-wicket for a run.
Floated on off, worked to covers.
Just 3 from Shakib's first over! Floated on off, this is defended out.
On middle, kept out.
Fuller, but drifting around leg, this is clipped nicely through short fine leg for a couple of runs.
Around middle and off, KP glances this to mid-wicket.
Fuller on off, this is pushed to mid on.
Goes low and works this through square leg for one.
Time for some spin by Shakib Al Hasan, as he is handed the ball now.
This is solidly kept out by the batter this time. 4 off the over only!
Comes down the track and eases the ball through mid on for a single.
Floated on the pads, this is tucked to square leg and the strike is rotated.
Swept hard to the right of the deep mid-wicket fielder for a single.
On the pads, glanced to square leg for a single. Given as a leg bye, so must have come off his pads.
Flatter and outside off, KP punches to covers for one.

Direct hit would have had him! What a close chance and a lifeline to Mendis now. Around off, length, worked towards mid on and Mendis is on his bike, down the track, looking for one. Perera sends him back and a throw comes in, but luckily for Mendis, it is missed. Had the fielder hit, that would have been very close.
Outside off, dabbed through short third man and the strike is handed to the other Kusal.
FOUR LEG BYES. A length ball, drifting down the leg side, Kusal Perera looks for the tuck away but misses. The ball takes the pad and runs away to the fine leg fence.
Shortish and wide outside off, Kusal Mendis punches this through point for one.
Shortish and on off, pulled to fine leg and the strike is rotated again.
A back of a hand slower full toss on middle, Perera swivels and pulls, where the short fine leg fielder misfields and allows the batters to come back for the second run.
Just 4 from the over! This is fired on middle, swept away to short fine leg. Tidy from Hasan!
Flatter and around off, Mendis goes back and tucks it towards square leg.
Stroked through covers for a single.
Arm ball, coming in with the angle around off and middle, KP defends it out with grace.
On middle, nudged through mid-wicket for one.
WIDE. Spinning down the leg side now, Mendis leaves. Wide signalled.
Shortish and around off, Kusal Perera places this in the gap at covers for one.
Mehidy is back! 0/30 from his 5 overs so far. How will he fare in his second spell?
Swing and a miss! A length ball angled across the right-hander, the batter swings his blade at this, but fails to make any contact with the ball.
Nicely fielded by the man there! Straying on the pads, this is nudged to the right of the short fine leg man, who dives and saves a run for his side. A single, in the end.
Outside off on a good length, this is pushed away to the man at covers.
A slower length ball on off, KP blocks it out well.
Around off, this is steered through backward point for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Kusal Mendis looks to go fishing but the ball zips past the outside edge.

DRINKS! This has been a good start from Sri Lanka, even though they have lost 2 batters in quick succession. The skipper has scored his fifty and is leading from the front for the Island nation. Now, they will want to continue the same and keep the scoreboard ticking. The hosts did well to pick 2 wickets after being on the back foot, but now will need to put the brakes on the run rate of Sri Lanka.

FOUR! Width on offer and Perera is quick to pounce on it.  That has been the highlight of his innings so far. Any loose delivery and the Sri Lankan skipper is there to make the most of it. Short and wide outside off, Perera slaps it over backward point and fetches his 9th boundary of the innings.
Around off, Mendis punches it to sweeper cover for one.

NOT OUT! Safely in! Good running! Length ball on top of middle and off. Perera taps it in front of point and calls for a quick run. Mendis is quick and gets inside his crease. The fielder scores a direct hit but Mendis is unscathed.
Run out appeal taken upstairs but Mendis looks safe.
Outside off, Mendis punches it past cover-point for one. Just his third run in 12 balls.
Good length ball around off, Mendis taps it to cover.

FIFTY FOR KUSAL PERERA! The captain is leading from the front for his side but he knows he will need to convert this into a telling hundred. His 15th fifty in ODIs. Full around off, Perera milks it to sweeper cover for a single to bring his mini milestone.
Full around off, Mustafizur tumbles while delivering this ball. Mendis drives it straight to mid off.
Good length delivery on off, Mendis taps it to point.
Slower ball! This is bowled into the surface on middle. Perera pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Good fielding. The hosts have looked very good on the field today. Short outside off, Perera cuts it to the left of point. The fielder there dives and saves runs for his side.
Length ball on off, Perera punches it but finds cover.
FOUR! Perera continues to impress out in the middle. Shorter on off, Perera pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary. God start to the over. How will the Fizz respond?
On off and middle on a length. Mendis taps it to mid on. Another good over from Taskin.
Play and a miss! Short and wide outside off, Mendis throws kitchen sink at it but gets nothing on it.
Ohh! Very good ball from Taskin. Good line and length. It is in the corridor of uncertainty around off. Mendis looks to defend but the ball shapes away and beats the outside edge of Mendis' willow.
Edged but safe! Good length ball around off, Perera looks to hit it through covers on the up but the ball shapes away. It takes the outside edge and goes to third man on the bounce.
Good fielding! Wide outside off, Mendis cuts it with power to the left of point. Mehidy there dives and takes pace off the ball. Saves three for his side.
On the pads, Perera glances it to fine leg and rotates the strike.
Back of a length delivery outside off. Perera late cuts it to third man and keeps the strike.
Kusal Mendis is off the mark! Length ball wide outside off, Mendis runs it down to third man for a run.
Good length ball around off, Mendis punches it but finds backward point.
Full on middle and off, Mendis defends it with a straight bat.
Short and wide outside off, Mendis leaves it alone.
On the pads, Perera turns it to the leg side for one.
Kusal Mendis walks out at number 4!

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Nissanka departs without troubling the scorers and Taksin gets his second in the over. Fantastic comeback from Taskin and Bangladesh. Sri Lanka were looking so good but this over has changed that. Taskin comes wide of the crease and bowls it outside off. The ball comes back in with the angle. Nissanka plays away from him with very little movement. There is some extra bounce on this delivery too. The ball takes the outside edge and goes to the right of Mushfiqur Rahim. He makes no mistake and takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mushfiqur Rahim b Taskin Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Good ball! Good length delivery in the channel of uncertainty outside off. Nissanka has a poke at it and luckily does not edge it.
Fuller on the stumps, Nissanka defends it.
Good length ball outside off, Nissanka starts his innings with a calm leave.
Pathum Nissanka walks out at number 3!

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Taskin strikes and Bangladesh have the first breakthrough! A questionable shot selection from Gunathilaka and he will be fuming to not capitalize on the start he got. Gunathilaka was looking very good out in the middle but his innings has been cut short.  Back of a length delivery just outside off. Gunathilaka goes for the big pull across the line. The ball is not short or wide enough to go for the shot. The ball takes the inside edge and goes onto hit middle and off. Taskin is elated and why wouldn't he be? He has had a tough start but he is coming back in this game.
WIDE! This time Taskin misses his line and sprays it down the leg side. Wided by the umpire.
WIDE! Overcooked bouncer! Gunathilaka looks to pull but it is over his head.
Short on middle, Perera pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Dot! Short ball outside off, Gunathilaka sways away from it. Good start for the Fizz. Just 2 from his first!
Good length ball on top of middle. Perera whips it to fine leg for one.
Length ball on middle and off, Gunathilaka milks it to third man and rotates.
Swing and a miss! Full and wide outside off, Gunathilaka looks to go over mid off but misses.
Fuller on middle, Gunathilaka flicks it but finds mid-wicket inside the circle.
Mustafizur starts with a good length ball on off. Gunathilaka pushes it back to the bowler.
Powerplay 2 signalled by the umpire! Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Mustafizur Rahman to inaugurate the second phase of the innings.
Dot to finish Powerplay 1! Flighted on the stumps, Perera blocks it. Excellent Powerplay 1 for Sri Lanka. The tourists are 77/0 at the end of the first phase.
Flat and on off, Gunathilaka punches it to long off for one.
SIX! BOOM! First biggie of the game and pressure on Mehidy. Tossed up too full on middle, it is in the slot for Gunathilaka. He slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for the first maximum of the day.
FOUR! Short and just outside off. Gunathilaka takes the risk and drags it from there over short mid-wicket for a boundary.
Floated on middle, Gunathilaka keeps it out.
Short and close to off stump. Gunathilaka cuts it but finds backward point.

FOUR! Poor ball and gets punished! Drifting down the leg side, Perera glances it past the diving short fine leg fielder and the ball races away to the fence.  Expensive start for Taskin too. 12 from his first!
Some problem for Perera and the physio is out to have a look now.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Perera tucks it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
WIDE! Taskin attempts the slower one but misses his radar completely. He bowls it too far down the leg side. Perera does not even try playing that.
Full on off and middle, Gunathilaka turns it to the on side for one.
On the pads, Kusal flicks it through square leg for one.
Follows the boundary with a single to the on side. Smart cricket.
FOUR! Taskin is welcomed with a boundary! Short on middle from Taskin to begin with. It is not short enough to to trouble Gunathilaka, He pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Change in bowling. The Mosaddek plan has not worked for Tamim so he has taken him off the attack. Taskin Ahmed is into the attack for the first time in this game.
Another one on the pads, Gunathilaka has no qualms to just glance it to the on side and keep the strike.
On the pads, Perera tucks it behind square legt and calls for a quick run. Gunathilaka responds well and gets in safely at the keeper's end.
Flat on the stumps, Perera blocks it.
Tossed up on off, Perera keeps it out.
Floated on off, another one milked to long off for one.
Slower through the air on off, Perera milks it to long off for one.
Short outside off, Gunathilaka goes chasing after it but mistimes it to the on side.
On middle, Gunathilaka blocks it.

FOUR! Sri Lanka's 50 is up in quick time and it has come without any damage. Short and wide outside off, Gunathilaka says thank you very much and cuts it through backward point for a boundary. The ply to bowl Mosaddek early is backfiring.
Floated on the stumps, this time Gunathilaka blocks it.
FOUR! Mosaddek continues to be short. He was lucky to come out unscathed the previous delivery but not so lucky this time. Shott and wide outside off, Gunathilaka cuts it past point for a boundary.
Short on middle, Perera pulls it hard but there is a man at deep mid-wicket so just a run.
Short outside off, Gunathilaka punches it through cover-point. Mahmudullah gives it a chase and pulls it before the ropes with a slide. Saves a couple for his team.
Flat and quick on middle, Gunathilaka punches it to mid off.
Floated on the stumps, DG defends it.
Floated on off, Gunathilaka pushes it back to the bowler.
Short on off, Gunathilaka punches it to cover.

Lucky escape for Perera! He comes down the track so Mehidy darts it quicker. There is some turn on this one. Perera looks to hit it over long on but gets a little outside edge which sees the ball go towards third man. The fielder gives it a chase and manages to pull it before the rope. Three taken.
Short again but this time Perera mistimes his pull through mid-wicket and keeps the strike. 9 off Mosaddek Hossain's first.
FOUR! Short and punished again! Short on middle and off, Perera pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flighted on off and middle, Perera is happy to keep it out.
Short on middle and off, Perera gets on his back foot and punches it to cover.
Floated on off, Perera blocks it.
FOUR! Faulty start for Mosaddek! He starts with a short one on off, Perera latches onto it quickly and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Change in bowling. First one of the game and it sees Mosaddek Hossain come into the attack in place of Shoriful Islam!
Flat and quick on off,  Gunathilaka dabs it to short third man to see off the over.
Floated on off, Perera nudges it to long off for a single.
Floated on off, Perera blocks it this time.
FOUR! Perera looks in the mood. Mehidy drifts a little down the leg side, Kusal gets on his knee and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Flatter on off, Perera punches it back to the bowler.

Good fielding from Afif! Saves a run for his side. Short and spinning away outside off, Gunathilaka punches it through cover. Afif at long off gives it a chase and does really well to pull it back before the fence.
Length delivery outside off, Perera punches it but straight to the man at short cover. 8 off the over. Shoriful is struggling at the minute. 17 from his 2 so far.
Shortish outside off, Perera looks to pull but misses.
FOUR! This time Perera connects and gets the result! Full outside off, Perera goes over cover. He does not time it well but gets enough to send it over the in field and see the ball reach the fence.
Swing and a miss! Fuller outside off, Perera swings but the ball keeps low and goes under his bat.
Good length delivery on off, Perera looks to punch but hits it back to the bowler off the inner half of his bat.
FOUR! Short and punished! It is short on middle and off, Perera is quick to pick it up. The ball sits up well and Perera pulls it with power over square leg for a boundary.
Dot to finish the over. Just 2 off Mehidy's first. The last ball is short and wide outside off, Gunathilaka cuts but cannot find the gap as he finds the fielder at point.
Tossed up slower through the air on middle. Perera turns it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up slower through the air on middle. Perera turns it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Short outside off, Perera punches it to the right of cover. The fielder there dives and saves runs for his side.
Floated on off, Perera blocks it to the off side.
Mehidy starts with a floated delivery on the pads, Gunathilaka tucks it to the leg side for one.
Who will bowl from the other end with the other new ball? It will be the spin of Mehidy Hasan!
0.6: Shoriful Islam to Kusal Perera, Wide outside off but inside the tramline. Perera leaves it alone. Good start for Sri Lanka, 9 off the first over.
The wind is getting heavy and there is some movement of the groundstaff. Hope the game can continue.
Much better from Shoriful! Targets the stump and bowls it on a length on middle and off. Perera pushes it to mid off.
Good length ball around off, Perera punches it off the inner half to mid on.
FOUR! Kusal Perera does what his partner did and gets off the mark with a boundary too. Too short and wide outside off. Perera cuts it with power through point for a boundary.
Shoriful changes his line and goes fuller on off. Gunathilaka tucks it away from mid on and gets a boundary.

FOUR! Lovely start for Sri Lanka! Gunathilaka gets the tourists up and running with a boundary! Shoriful starts with a length delivery outside off, Gunathilaka waits for it and punches it behind point for a boundary.

We are all set for the action to begin! The Bangladesh players make their way out on the field. Sri Lankan skipper, Kusal Perera walks out with Danushka Gunathilaka to open the innings for the tourists. Shoriful Islam is all set to operate with the new ball first up!

PITCH REPORT - Tino Mawoyo is the pitch master for the day. Mawoyo says that the temperature is lower and there might be some rain today. Adds that there is a lot more grass on this surface and thinks that this will be a very good pitch for batting. About the outfield, he says that it might be slow due to the rain that has been going on for the last couple of days.

Bangladesh Playing XI: Tamim Iqbal (C), Mohammad Naim, Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Mahmudullah, Mosaddek Hossain, Afif Hossain, Mehidy Hasan Miraz, Taskin Ahmed, Shoriful Islam, Mustafizur Rahman.

Sri Lanka Playing XI: Kusal Perera (C), Danushka Gunathilaka, Pathum Nissanka, Kusal Mendis, Niroshan Dickwella (WK), Dhanajaya Da Silva, Wanindu Hasaranga, Ramesh Mendis, Chamika Karunaratne, Binura Fernando, Dushmantha Chameera.
TOSS - After a brief delay it is time for the toss. The two captains are out in the middle. Tamim Iqbal has the coin in hand. Up it goes. Kusal Perera calls correctly. SRI LANKA OPT TO BAT!
UPDATE 1134 local (0634 GMT) - Not the news we were looking to bring you but it is raining and the covers are on. It will be a delayed start but let's hope it is not a lengthy delay.

Hello and welcome to the third and final ODI between Bangladesh and Sri Lanka. The hosts have been excellent and would look to end the series with a whitewash and strengthen their grip at the top of the World Cup Super League table. Sri Lanka have been good with the ball but it's the bat that hasn't done the talking for Kusal Perera's men. The new skipper would like to end his first series with a win and get their first win of the World Cup Super League. Will Bangladesh be able to put the cherry on top or will Sri Lanka leave Bangladesh with a win? Stay tuned for toss and further updates.
